//: Emit build used by `npm run prepare`. Distinct from tsconfig.json (typecheck only): bin/novahiz.mjs imports dist/cli.js when the package runs from node_modules, so the output root must be dist/cli.js — hence rootDir src. Every source file imports its siblings with a .ts extension (Node's type stripping), and rewriteRelativeImportExtensions turns those specifiers into .js in the emitted JavaScript.
